QUIC connection, packet, stream, TLS, and service logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the main `fd_quic` engine for QUIC version 1. It provides the construction API for `fd_quic_t`, including memory layout calculation, object creation and deletion, environment-based configuration, and join/leave functions for shared-memory use. It also initializes and validates the internal state for connections, TLS handshakes, stream pools, packet metadata, timers, logging, and metrics. The file defines the public entry points that create client and server connections, open and send on streams, close connections, and drive service and wakeup processing.

The file also contains the core packet receive and transmit logic for QUIC. It parses IPv4 and UDP headers, decodes QUIC long and short headers, handles `Initial`, `Handshake`, `Retry`, `0-RTT`, and `1-RTT` packets, processes frames, manages ACK generation and loss recovery, and performs TLS callback handling for secrets, peer transport parameters, and handshake completion. On transmit, it selects the correct encryption level, builds QUIC frames such as ACK, CRYPTO, STREAM, `MAX_DATA`, `MAX_STREAMS`, `PING`, and close frames, applies packet protection, and sends the result through the configured AIO transmit interface.
